**1.3.1: fixes Sync on Windows**

- **Ticking a book on the e-reader screen no longer crashes Book Forge on Windows.** The crash also meant Sync never ran; tick the books you want on the reader and press Sync, and they're copied as expected.

Everything from 1.3 is included: Book Forge converts to and from Kindle books by itself, so Calibre isn't needed. The Mac app is unchanged from 1.3 (the crash only affected Windows and Linux).

**Install**
- **Mac** (macOS 26, Apple silicon): download `Book-Forge.zip`, unzip it and move Book Forge to Applications. The app isn't notarized, so right-click it and choose Open the first time.
- **Windows:** download `Book-Forge-Windows.zip`, unzip it somewhere it can stay and double-click `Install.cmd` (replace your old Book Forge folder). If Windows warns about an unknown publisher, choose More info → Run anyway.
- **Linux:** download `Book-Forge-Linux.tar.gz`, unpack it and run `./install.sh`.
